row:
We are a not for profit educational body, established in 2003 by The Life Centre, one of the UK's top yoga centres, to train members of the yoga community. Consistent with our not for profit status we keep course and tuition fees as low as we can in order to make our training as accessible as possible to all members of the yoga community.

We offer one of the UK's top yoga teacher training courses (accredited by Yoga Alliance) and provide specialist training in teaching yoga for pregnancy, children and families. We also offer specialist training in yoga therapy as well as a range of other courses, workshops and events for all levels of students. Many of our courses are taught by some of the most respected teachers in the world and all are run by a friendly and supportive team of yogis.
